name: Mo' Bettahs (Utah Locations) Tender Kalua Pig with Steamed White Rice
brandOrRestaurant: Mo' Bettahs Hawaiian Style Food (Utah Locations)
whyItWorks: Slow-steamed smoked pork shoulder that falls apart with a fork. Lightly salted with Hawaiian sea salt, zero acidic sauces, and paired with fluffy white jasmine rice.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Kalua Pig plate with double white rice (substitute extra white rice for macaroni salad).
watchOuts: Substitute white rice for macaroni salad if gluten or mayo sensitive
